protocol.calibration_reason: Only3 validation dates; independent calibration plus>=2 threshold dates is unsupported after strict24h purge.

walk_forward.purpose: pre-primary-holdout descriptive robustness only; no selection or refitting primary models

uncertainty.block: one prediction day; all models/windows resample the same days
uncertainty.few_days_policy: paired per-day and leave-one-day-out descriptive ranges; no confidence/significance claim

protocol.prior_exposure: T17 test dates overlap this study; fixed-protocol same-source temporal comparison, not pristine independent validation.

paired_uncertainty.interpretation: Days/participants/pairs are dependent; descriptive sensitivity is not a confidence interval or significance test.
